name: Abs Crunch (Bodyweight)
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat, hands lightly behind your head or crossed on your chest.
Exhale and curl your ribs toward your pelvis, lifting your head and shoulder blades off the floor.
Pause for a second at the top without pulling on your neck.
Lower slowly until your shoulder blades touch the floor again.
Keep your lower back in contact with the floor throughout.
cues: Chin off the chest, eyes on the ceiling
longevityNotes: A strong, stable core protects the spine in every other movement and makes daily tasks — bending, twisting, reaching — safer. Core endurance matters more than core power.
overview: A basic floor crunch that shortens the rectus abdominis through a small, controlled range of motion.

commonMistakes: Yanking the head forward with the hands
Using momentum rather than the abs
Lifting the whole torso like a sit-up
safetyNotes: Keep the neck neutral. If you feel neck strain, cross your arms over your chest instead.
